"Temporary conversations disappear when the process ends. Permanent chats are encrypted; retention is configured in Settings."
"Stop the response in this chat first."
"This conversation will be removed from the device. The model and other chats will remain."
"Permanent chat storage will be enabled. Only this chat becomes permanent; other temporary chats will not be saved."
"The saved copy will be deleted. The current conversation remains in RAM until the process ends."
"Chats stay in the main list. Their conversations will not be deleted."
"GGUF import, Hugging Face, profiles and storage"
"Off by default. At about 80% context, the model creates a summary that may miss details and uses extra API requests. Originals stay in the chat."
"For local models with switchable thinking. Configure API reasoning in the provider connection."

"A foreground service supports a response you explicitly started. Deep Doze can delay CPU/network work. You can manually allow unrestricted background use; the app never changes system settings itself."
"\n\nYou can continue temporary chats. Resetting deletes inaccessible saved chats and folders; this cannot be undone."
"Delete all saved chats and the history key? Model settings and provider keys will remain."
"All chats stay in memory only. History disappears when the process ends."
"Permanent chats are encrypted on your device. Temporary chats are not saved."
"Encrypted history is deleted after a selected period of inactivity."
"Choose what stays on your device. Temporary chats are never saved to disk."
"All saved copies will be deleted. Conversations already in RAM stay temporary until the process ends. Folder settings will remain."
"Retention starts from the last activity. Android may delay background cleanup; expired chats are hidden when opened. An active response finishes first."
"Apply this retention period to all permanent chats? History older than this period will be deleted."
"Interface language does not change your messages or the model\'s response language."
"Russian or English; English for other languages"

"The summary replaces earlier messages only in the model\'s input and may miss details. Originals stay in the chat. Undo restores the full original context, which may exceed the model\'s window again."
"Auto-compaction is paused for this chat after an undo or error."
"Auto-compaction is on: runs before sending at about 80% of the window including response reserve."
"Auto-compaction is off. Enable it in Settings → Chats."
"Catalogue window: %1$s. API usage is estimated from reported usage and text size; images and PDFs may use more. Enter the model\'s actual window if the catalogue did not provide it."
"The same model will process earlier conversation and create a summary. "
"This uses up to 16 additional requests to this provider at its rates. You can then review and apply the result."
"This takes time on your phone. You can then review and apply the result."
"Compaction started. The completed summary will appear above the conversation; you can review it before applying."
"Response reserve: %1$s\nContext and usage are determined by the provider"
"Only a local model is served. Client requests are not saved as your chats."
"Load the selected model and wait until it is ready"
"Loopback: HTTP + Bearer. Wi-Fi: TLS and Bearer are required; the client must trust the certificate. Server stops if the address or process is lost; do not expose it to the internet."
"Connect an existing GGUF or download a model from Hugging Face."
"A model operation is in progress. Cancel it from the notification."
"Import sources are kept. Disconnecting an external file only removes its registration."
"\nThe managed copy will be deleted. The import source is not affected."
"You will not be able to resume it after deletion."
"Experimental. The first response can take tens of minutes; a full 32K window has only been checked on isolated retrieval tasks. Free RAM is required."
"Long input takes several minutes to process."
"CPU · F16 KV · original weights · no history truncation."
"Chat prefix cache in RAM: 128 MiB (up to 8K)"

"Wait for the current operation to finish"

"You can minimize the app or turn the screen off: the model keeps working. Permission allows a ‘Response ready’ notification without conversation text. If you decline, chat still works, but no completion notification is shown."
"HTTPS server is already off. Turn it on and export again."
"Certificate saved. Configure the client to trust it; do not disable TLS verification."
"Chats share one engine. Request text is not saved. Server stops after Wi-Fi or process changes. LAN requires trust in the exported certificate and a Bearer token."
"Default: 127.0.0.1:8080, HTTP + token. Accessible only from this phone or explicit ADB port forwarding. Enable Wi-Fi for computer access without ADB. Do not expose the port to the internet."

"Model copy verified. The source document provider does not support safe deletion from the app. Delete the original manually in a file manager if needed; the verified copy is kept."
"Stop the current operation and unload the model before deleting the source. Chats remain in RAM."

"Address: %1$s

HTTP itself does not encrypt conversations, files, API keys or headers. Anyone who can intercept the connection can read or change them. Tailscale encrypts traffic between its nodes while the VPN is connected, but llamur cannot verify the route.

Allow only a server you trust. Permission is saved for this exact address and port. Changing the address requires confirmation again."
